title: Registration complete
content:
[TRADER] Registration complete

## General TPN Search/ Track Application The user who wishes to register into eCMS for trade related activity, should first update there TPN details in RAMIS system from DRC office. Once the Trader/individual has updated their details, they can check in there TPN under the TPN Search/Track Application to check if the TPN is available in eCMS. Go to your browser: type in www.ecms.gov.bt . In the home page under the heading eCMS e-Services. Click on the TPN Search/ Track Application: ## The below screen gets populated, here in you need to key in the primary TPN: Type in the primary TPN: ## The list of TPN associated to the trader will get populated, as the TPN has been updated in RAMIS: Select the TPN which you wish to do trade and authorize the CFA with. For example: Here the user wishes to do trade with TPN DAC00061_01 for trade, so we take that TPN to do the registration or do CFA authorization. ## CFA Authorization Type in url: www.ecms.gov.bt Under the eCMS e-Services, Click on CFA Authorization/De-authorization. ## OTP Authentication Here in we add the we want to use for trade and authorize the CFA for trade related activity: ## Details: TPN: The TPN of the Registered Trader ## Mobile: mobile number to get the OTP Email id: email id to get the OTP Note: The user has to key in either mobile no or the email id for the OTP authentication. Key in the OTP received, and the validation happens, and the Registration tab appears. ## Click on the Registration Tab Select the option Apply CFA Authorization ## Fill in the details in the field: Details: CFA TPN: add in the CFA TPN to authorize the CFA for trade related activity. CFA name and CFA License Number gets auto- populated. Start Date and End Date: the date for the authorization period needs to be mentioned. ## Click on Submit button to Submit the application The Application number gets generated for tracking. Once the application has been approved by the customs, the trader and CFA will be notified through the registered mail: ## CFA De-authorization Type in url: www.ecms.gov.bt ## Under the eCMS e-Services, Click on CFA Authorization/De-authorization: OTP Authentication ## Details: TPN: The TPN of the Registered Trader ## Mobile: mobile number to get the OTP Email id: email id to get the OTP Note: The user has to key in either mobile no or the email id for the OTP authentication. Key in the OTP received, the validation happens, and the Registration tab appears. ## Click on the Registration Tab Select the option Cancel CFA Authorization \ ## Select the dropdown My Authorized CFA TPN It will list the CFA TPN authorized. Select the one you want the deauthorize. Click Submit. ## The deauthorization remark for cancellation The deauthorization or cancellation mail notification will be sent to the concern trader and CFA registered mail: ## Registration OTP based Authentication for Registration The OTP based verification will ensure that the user who is applying for registration of a TPN in eCMS is a valid and authorized user. eCMS will send an OTP to the registered mobile or email of the TPN as available in eCMS TPN Master through RAMIS/BITS integration. Once the OTP is validated in eCMS, system will consider the user as valid and allow the user to register in eCMS (Please refer to Registration SRS for the various types of Registration). For registration purpose, we will need to first go into the OTP based authentication where in you will be allowed to key in your TPN, registered email address and phone number to receive the OTP for authentication as in the process below: To get into the authentication the users are to key in the url: www.ecms.gov.bt and then Click on Registration as highlighted below: ## Figure 1.home screen Step 1: User clicks on the Registration link in the eCMS Portal. System will navigate to OTP Authentication page. ## Figure 2.OTP Authentication Screen 1 Step 2: User provides necessary details and clicks on Generate OTP. System validates and sends OTP to the user. After successful sending of OTP, system enables the OTP entry for the user. User will need to key in the OTP received from eCMS to the registered email or the phone number and click on Validate OTP. ## Figure 3.OPT Authentication Screen 2 Step 3: System will validate the OTP and, if it is found to be correct, it will allow the user to proceed with Registration. ## Figure 4.Registration List Registration for FE Users: ## To register into e-CMS: After the OTP authentication is completed, the user can then select the user they want to register into as shown in the Figure 4. The individual user can register themselves as the following: ## You can choose the option from the list for registration: Trader Registration: ## Click >>Trader Registration: The subsequent screen will be displayed: ## Party Details: Input TPN Number: The system will validate if the TPN Number is PIT – The filed to add in the CID number will be appeared and if you select BIT & CIT – the filed to add in the Trade License number will be appeared. ## TPN number if for PIT, the below screen shall be shown: Figure 6.Trader Party details Application Details: general information of an individual. ## Document Details Summary Details and Submit Summary details provides the view of certain details filled in by the user and the user need to tick the acknowledge and submit the same. Once submitted Registration number will be genetrated which shall be used to get the status: ## Click Submit >> The application is submitted, and Reg No is provided to you for tracking CFA Registration: ## Click >>CFA Registration The subsequent screen will be displayed: ## Party Details: Application Details: ## Document Details Summary Details and Submit ## This will give the preview of the details one filled for registration, as shown below: Click Submit >> The application is submitted, and Reg No is provided to you for tracking ## Bonded Warehouse Operator (BWH) Registration Click >> BWH Registration ## The subsequent screen will be displayed: Party Details: ## Application Details: Document Details ## Summary Details and Submit This will give the preview of the details one filled for registration, as shown below: ## Click Submit >> The application is submitted, and Reg No is provided to you for tracking Temporary Storage Operator (TSO) ## Click >> TSO Registration The subsequent screen will be displayed: ## Party Details: Application Details: ## Document Details Summary Details and Submit ## This will give the preview of the details one filled for registration, as shown below: Click Submit >> The application is submitted, and Reg No is provided to you for tracking Note: Approval process is done by Custom Officer, once approval is done the user will receive the mail with username and default password ## Password send to the provided registered mail id as shown below: Logging in to eCMS After the registration is completed, the individual will be provided with the login credentials username and default password, which will be asked to set while login for the first. Once completed the user can login to the portal and perform the task associated. ## To login to the e-CMS FE: Type in URL: www.ecms.gov.bt in your Internet browser to access the e-CMS. ## Click on the Login you will be taken to the page to key in your username and password: Input the username and password that was created for the individual. (Trader, CFA, BWH, TSO), upon login with default the user will be asked to provide their own password for further use. After the process is done the user will be allowed to login with the password set by them self. For that click on Click Here to login After login in the user will be seeing their individual dashboard with various menu to perform different task. ## Logout of the FE Users: This function allows the user to log out from the application any time. User can sign out from the eCMS any time by simply clicking the button available at the upper right corner of the user logged-in window. ## Log Out Page Password Reset The function allows to reset the password if the user forgets the password. Click on the Forget Password under the login tab as shown under: The next page to key in the username and registered main along with the captcha to authenticate will be provided. Once the user provided the credentials, the default password will be sent to the registered mail provide. title: Road manifest
content:
[TRADER] Road manifest

## General Introduction Road manifests are submitted by Declarants and CFAs. In road manifest amendment and cancellation can be done unless it has been used in the declaration and pass release. ## Front End User The user needs to log into eCMS using the URL: www.ecms.gov.bt ## Click on login menu and provide the required credentials to log in to the system: Create Road Manifest ## Select Road Manifest for the list of menus provided in the dashboard as highlighted below: Under the Road Manifest menu, Select Create Road Manifest: ## Key in the following details: Road Manifest Header Select the Regime as import, export, transit, temporary import, temporary export, re-import and re-export, warehousing and fill in the details >> Save the details: ## Invoice Details Add New invoice and either save or save and go to the next page: ## Supporting Documents Details The declarant shall attach any supporting documents (invoice, packing list etc) for approval: ## Summary The declarant can review his/her road manifest declaration and submit the same for approval: ## Track Application An application Number will be Generated: ## The users will be able to track their application from Search Road Manifest: Update Road Manifest and Update Road Manifest Vehicle: User can apply for update of Road manifest in general or can apply update for just vehicle mentioned in the RM due to certain reasons. ## The road manifest is not used in a declaration or The consignment against the road manifest has not exited the country. ## Cancel Road Manifest User can cancel the Road Manifest that has already submitted and approved due to certain user error: The below screen will be provided for the user to do the cancel of a particular RM by providing the reason and remarks: ## My Party Road Manifest This tab gives the user the list of RM till date submitted by the user profile:

content:

## General Logging In Airlines: ## The user needs to log into eCMS using the url: www.ecms.gov.bt Click on login menu and provide the required credentials to log in to the system: ## Create Passenger Manifest Select passenger manifest from the list of menus provided in the dashboard: ## Under the Passenger Manifest menu, Select Create Passenger manifest: Key in the details under each menu provided: Manifest header: here need to provide the details of the flight and no of passenger details, filling in all the required ## Passengers: add in the details of the crew/ passenger for the manifest Summary: provide the summarized details of the detailed filed in for passenger manifest ## Track Application An application Number will be Generated: ## The users will be able to track their application from search passenger manifest: Update and Cancel Passenger Manifest The created and submitted passenger manifest can be updated or cancelled by providing the valid reasons. ## Click onto Update Passenger Manifest for update of the manifest Click onto Cancel Passenger Manifest for cancellation of the manifest

title: Air Cargo manifest
content:
[TRADER] Air Cargo manifest

## General Introduction Air manifest is submitted by Declarants and CFAs. Users manually create the manifest. Users can also mark air waybills as consolidated and assign the corresponding consolidating party. ## FE user The user needs to log into eCMS using the url: www.ecms.gov.bt ## Click on login menu and provide the required credentials to log in to the system: Create Air Cargo Manifest ## Select Air Cargo Manifest for the list of menus provided in the dashboard: Under the Air Cargo Manifest menu, Select Create Air Cargo Manifest: ## Key in the following details: Manifest Header: here the applicant needs to provide the details of the flight and no of passenger details, filling in all the required: ## Air waybills: to add in the airway bills details: Supporting Documents: The declarant shall attach any supporting documents (invoice, packing list etc) for approval: Summary: The declarant can review his/her air cargo manifest declaration and submit the same for approval: ## Track Application An application Number will be Generated: ## The users will be able to track their application from Search Air Cargo Manifest: Additional Air Cargo Manifest This will allow the user to create additional air cargo manifest, if they have missed additional detailed missed in the previous manifest: ## Amend Air Cargo Manifest The manifest that has been applied for can be amended that can be done by applying the amend request for the submitted manifest. ## Click on the Amend Air Cargo Manifest Click on the button to add in the request Fill in the details in the field providing but first need to select the Manifest number that needs to be amended, select the AWB Number then add in the reason for amendment >> Save ## Cancel Air Cargo Manifest The manifest that has been applied for can be cancelled. Cancellation happens to the manifest which has been submitted. ## Click on the Cancel Air Cargo Manifest Click on button to select the manifest which 1 needs to be cancelled. Select the manifest number under the tab Manifest Number, then the Manifest Cancellation Type. Here we have two and base on the selected the AWB Number mandatory filed gets highlighted. Fill in the required details and Submit. Air Manifest Cancellation number gets generated. Double click on the number and then press Submit button. Dialogue box with the application number gets generated. Once the cancellation is being approved by the concern officer, the status of the application can be viewed from the Search Air Cargo Manifest. ## Air Cargo House Manifest eCMS will enable the user to select a consolidated air waybill that assigned to the user’s party and use it to create a house manifest. House manifests can be created through manual input/upload. eCMS will also enable a customs officer to approve the submission. ## Create Air Cargo House Manifest While creating the Air Cargo Manifest, under the Bill of Lading Tab, if the user has selected the BL Type as Consolidated, then once the Air Cargo Manifest has been approved the declaration will then be available in the Create Air Cargo House Manifest, after that the user can create the Air cargo house manifest and submit the same by providing the details under each header. ## Amend and Cancel Air Cargo House Manifest The Air Cargo House Manifest once submitted can also be amended and cancelled. ## View Air Cargo Manifest Audit Details Gives the details of the actions considered into the Air Cargo Manifest.

title: Declaration
content:
[TRADER] Declaration

## General Introduction The declaration submission is the first step in the eCMS System. After submission, the declaration goes through processing by various department of Customs. This document also illustrates the overall processing of the various regimes supported by eCMS. ## Login as Front-end user The user needs to log into eCMS using the url: www.ecms.gov.bt ## Click on login menu and provide the required credentials to log in to the system: Declaration ## Select Declaration FE for the list of menus provided in the dashboard: Search Async Declaration: provides list of declaration that has been created, submitted from the initial to till date by the user for a particular party. ## Search and Edit Declaration: Provided the list for the following: Submitted Declaration list: list of declaration that has been submitted by the FE user. Draft declaration list: list of declaration that’s in draft state. ## Create Declaration Allows the user to create the declaration by selecting different regime. Once the regime is selected accordingly Declaration Type for each regime is populated. Selection of declaration type based on the regime selected. Continue with the filling of details in each tab. ## The regime and their declaration type are as follows: Based on the selection of the regime and declaration type the different tab details needs to be filled in. ## General Information: Select the Regime as Import >> Select Declaration type as per the requirement and get the details filled and save the data that has been completed. ## Bill of Lading The user needs to add in the Bill of landing wherein we must have Road Manifest details, that has been created and approved before the declaration is created: At times we have a container associated in the consignment, the details of the container will then have the be added under the Bill of Lading, into the Container details: ## Invoice and Consignor Add New invoice and consignor details >> add in the invoice details and commodities details >> Save ## Supporting Documents The declarant shall attach mandatory supporting documents (invoice) for approval: ## Summary The declarant can review his/her declaration summary and submit the same for approval, here we have the check box to accept the terms and condition. Here the user can validate the declaration before submission. The user can submit the declaration which will allow the user to generate the reference declaration number. ## Search Amendment Request Provide the list of declaration that has been requested for amendment. ## Create Amendment Request From the list of declaration, one can request for amendment. Click on the declaration for which amendment is required. Select the reasons from the dropdown list. Provide the remarks for amendment. Press submit button. ## Search Cancellation Provide the list of declaration that has been requested for cancellation. ## Create Cancellation From the list of declaration, one can request for cancellation. Click on the declaration for which cancellation is required. Select the reasons from the dropdown list. Provide the remarks for cancellation. Press submit button. ## Search Transit Amendment Provide the list of declaration with regime Transit that has been requested for amendment. ## Create Transit Amendment From the list of transit declaration, one can request for cancellation. Click on the declaration for which cancellation is required. Select the reasons from the dropdown list. Provide the remarks for amendment. title: Manifest Approval
content:
[CUSTOMS] Manifest Approval

## General Introduction The Custom Official has the right to approve the application that has been submitted by the Front-end user. This document provides you the guide for approval of Manifest in the eCMS. ## There are 3 different Manifest: Road Manifest ## Passenger Manifest Air Cargo Manifest ## Logging in as Custom Officer The user needs to log into eCMS using the url: www.ecms.gov.bt ## Click on login menu and provide the required credentials to log in to the system: Road Manifest Transaction of import and export that happens through road required Road Manifest, which needs prior approval from the DRC office. title: Valuation
content:
[CUSTOMS] Valuation

## General Introduction Customs Valuation is one of the sub-systems in the CMS component of the eCMS system. In this sub-system, Customs valuation unit creates and uses the historical transaction data as reference for valuation of all commodities in the declaration. Specific profile-based valuation range may also be defined when valuation officers are sure on the valuation of certain commodities meeting certain criteria. Profile based valuations are used to target specific cases of valuation frauds and “as such” will be used less frequently than transaction based. This valuation sub-system also captures the value based on last transactions made during the period for all the HS Codes. For transaction method, the system builds the valuation database. Profile based or transaction-based valuation can be selected based on the HS Code. Once eCMS receives the declaration, the declaration value is verified with the valuation database or the profile if configured. The valuation assessment will indicate if the goods are “under value” or “overvalued” or cleared. The valuation assessing officer may update his inputs on the valuation. Valuation process is involved in Import, Transit, Warehouse, Temporary Import, Re-Import Regime flows. ## Logging in as Valuation Officer The user needs to log into eCMS using the url: www.ecms.gov.bt ## Click on login menu and provide the required credentials to log in to the system: Valuation Click on the menu Valuation. ## Create Global Criteria The Global Valuation criteria refers to the default criteria for all the Items and is considered when there are no available Specific Valuation criteria for the H.S Code of that corresponding item. This functionality allows Customs control to establish the verification criteria based on the historical valuation records available in eCMS system and the past transaction details captured in the eCMS system. The configuration set for the criteria is used to check the value declared by the Declarant for an Item in the declaration that falls in the Customs criteria value or not. ## Click on Create Global Criteria Click on to add the Global Criteria Details Select the valuation Type from drop down list >> Number of days/transactions>>provide the Percentile Lower >> percentile Upper>> Select Status (Active/Non Active)>> Save The Global Criteria gets create and can be viewed in the list. ## HS Code Criteria Click on HS Code Criteria ## Click on to add the HS Code Criteria Select the BTC Code from drop down list >> Select the Valuation Type>>Provide the number of Days/Transactions >> Provide Percentile Lower>> Provide Percentile Upper Select Status (Active/Non Active)>> Save The HS Code Criteria gets create and can be viewed in the list. ## Valuation Profile The profile-based configuration for valuation criteria is a process of setting the specific profile with valuation boundaries i.e. upper and lower limits with variance at HS Code level. \ ## Click on Valuation Profile Click on to add the Valuation Profile Provide the Profile details and Associated Criteria >> Save the same. The list gets create and can be viewed in the list. ## Minimum Price List Click on Minimum Price List ## Click on to add the Minimum Price List Select the BTC Code from drop down list >> Select the UOM>>Provide Declaration>> Provide Minimum Value Price>> Select Status (Active/Non-Active)>> Save The list gets create and can be viewed in the list. ## Search Valuation List Go to Valuation menu and click on “Search Valuation List”. List of declaration that has gone through valuation or pending for valuation gets populated. ## Pending Valuation List Go to Valuation menu and click on “Pending Valuation List”. List of declaration that pending Valuation will be populated. Select the declaration for valuation >> provide the results for valuation then update the status >> Submit the declaration.

title: Offence
content:
[CUSTOMS] Offence

## General Introduction Offence module in Electronic Customs Management System (eCMS) allows Policy Sections to manage the complete lifecycle of an offence under Customs Rules and Regulations of Bhutan Revised Edition 2023. This module also enables Intelligence Agencies to report the offences. This module includes management of Offence Reports, processing of offence reports, Offence Case Files, managing inquiries, orders, notices etc. This user manual provides a detailed guide for Officers to work with this module. ## Create Offence: - eCMS enables an offence officer to complete offence reports that have been created by a declaration goods inspection failure reported by a customs officer. eCMS also allows an offence officer to create ad-hoc offence reports due to risk/intelligence failure. An offence can involve personnel or declaration goods. The offence report will also contain the demand note to pay and the action applied on the goods involved. ## Offence routed through Inspection Logging in as Custom Officer ## The user needs to log into eCMS using the url: www.ecms.gov.bt Click on login menu and provide the required credentials to log in to the system: ## Do the approval process of declaration Approves / Rejects for Amendment/ Reject the declaration. ## In case of the different status: Rejects for amendment the declaration is send back to the concern declarant with the remarks for rejection: Reject: the declaration submitted is being rejected with remarks for rejection. ## Approved: the declaration submitted has been approved and then moves for payment Once approved payment needs to be proceeded with the generation of the receipt and share the same to the respective declarant via SMS and mail for payment. ## Payment To do the same following are the steps: ## Click >> Payment CMS Select -> Pending Voucher -> Select the declaration for payment -> provide the details under each tab -> Payment number gets generated. Select -> Pending Payment -> provide the required details and submit. ## Valuation of the declaration The declaration moves to valuation tab, where in the concern officer will provide the details as per his/her finding from the valuation. ## Under valuation the list of items can be valuated, and the following are the finding: All the items are evaluated individually, and data is also updated individually, for that: Click >> Valuation Tab >> Select Pending Valuation List (list of declaration that needs to be valuated will be populated for the valuation) ## Once selected the valuation details has the tab: Declaration Details: provided the details for declaration and declaration date: Valuation Result: Here in the list of items from the declaration that needs to be evaluated. Select -> Item from the list of items from the declaration. ## The details pop up that needs to be filled in with the valuation data: Here in Custom Value needs to be added in as per the valuation. Once the value is added the Result Tab, selected the details and update the same. ## After the valuation is done and any of the item is found to be as follows: Inside Define Range – The item gets cleared. Under Value - then it will go further for Risk assessment. ## Centralized Risk Click >> Centralized Risk ## Select -> Pending Risk Assessment Under Pending Risk Assessment ## Fill in the details for the Risk Assessment as per the details required and update the declaration Inspection Click >> Inspection. Select >> Create Physical Examination. ## Fill in all the details: Header: ## Containerized Cargo Non-Containerized Cargo ## Valuation Details Support Documents: attach the document required. Examination: here under the Physical Examination Status = Physical Examination failed (Amendment/Offence) ## Print out of the Physical Examination Report Offence Management Module ## Create Offence Select -> Create Offence ## Select the declaration which has been routed through inspection for offence and click on Create Offence is being created: ## Search Offence Report Gives the list of declaration under offence. Shows the list of offence that has been committed. Select the Offence that has been committed. Add in details on the offence as per the finding and Click on Update button. ## Assuming Offence here in each item level: Item 1 (Origin) – here the item has issue with origin so that has been recorded and provided with outcome as Detention and now will be shared to the Custom Warehouse. Item 2 (Valuation) – if the item has valuation offence, the item will be detained and send to Custom Warehouse Item 3 (Cleared) : if the item has no issue , it clear and the outcome of the item is updated as Released Under Summary tab – provides the summary of the offence that has been created. To check for the status offence, get the details from the list by providing the offence number as below: The Item that has been detained will now be added to the Custom Warehouse via concern authority. ## Custom Warehouse procedure for detained goods Click >> Customs Warehouse Select -> Admit Goods List of declaration with item gets populated and the item under each is being admitted to the warehouse. ## Seize process for detained goods The Offence gets reopened to check for the outcome by the concern officer, the status now will be changed from Detention to Seize. ## Click >> Offence Management System Select -> Search Offence Report ## Select the Offence that need to be worked onto Under the item change the Offence Outcome Requested as: Seize. The concern officer will now take the declaration and check for the status, here the status that will be shown is Declaration Amendment as shown below: ## Got to Declaration CMS >> Select Amendment by Customs Do the changes into the item where in the office was committed, in our case we have item1 having origin and item2 having under value. Here under the declaration the amendment is made by the concern official. ## General information no change Bill of landing Invoice and Consignor – as there was offence under item, update needs to be made on the item level. Amendment completed. The Status of the declaration will now be pending payment there was valuation mismatch. Next Go to Payment CMS, make the additional payment and submit. ## Release The concern official will now check the offence and status now will be Released. Status changed to Release the Official in charge of the Custom Warehouse, will release the goods accordingly. Once all release the offence status will be Closed.

content: Home About About eCMS Vision, Mission & Values Goals & Strategies Organizational Structure Publication Bhutan Trade Statistic Performance Indicator BTC and Tariff Schedule Customs Act of Bhutan Customs Rules and Regulation of Bhutan Annexures to Customs Rules and Regulation of Bhutan 2023 Customs Manual 2024 Excise Tax Act of Bhutan 2025 Excise Tax Rules and Regulations 2025 Advisories Tutorials Reports National Revenue Reports Time Release Study Report Customer Service Delivery Standard Report Contact LOGIN BHUTAN ELECTRONIC CUSTOMS MANAGEMENT SYSTEM-eCMS eCMS is a web-based application, that is accessible to all citizens and businesses wishing to conduct international trade that will consist, inter alia, of Customs Agents (Brokers), Importers, Exporters, freight forwarders and private citizens via the internet. The objective of eCMS is to modernize and improve customs procedures to reduce customs clearance time, facilitate trade of goods across Bhutan borders, whilst exercising requisite border controls in addition to: Assist traders to fulfil customs procedures Facilitate interaction with other cross border regulatory agencies (CBRAs), cargo handlers, and transporters Support Customs control procedures and administration. eCMS USERS eCMS will be accessible to ; Name Responsibilities Declarant Citizens engaging in international trade may apply to be Declarant, these will include citizens acting on their own behalf or on behalf of Clearing and Forwarding Agents or other Traders (e.g. Importers, Exporters, Projects and Government Agencies). Registration will give those persons access rights to complete and submit Customs Declarations (Import, Export, Transit, Warehouse). Traders This category will include citizens who interact with eCMS but who are not declarants and do not require prior registration and will include citizens who wish to make applications for Exemptions (including duty-free quotas), Appeals and Refunds. Transporter (Airlines and Haulers) To allow a high degree of security of goods entering Bhutan, all airlines and (road transport) haulers will be required to supply airline cargo and passenger manifests or vehicle goods/transport documents. eCMS will provide the facilities to load details of the documents. Warehouse Operators On arrival (imports) or prior to departure (exports), goods can be moved into a public or private warehouse for up to ninety (90) days. Airlines can also move duty free goods, to be sold on the aircraft, or consumables into stores.
